original_description: Generate fully licensed AI music, background music, sound effects, and video soundtracks from a simple prompt or a public video link. Sonilo can match audio to your video, keep speech clear, mix music or sound effects into a new video, and automatically lower background music under voiceovers. Use it for social videos, product demos, podcasts, ads, games, presentations, and more.
summary_ja: 指示や公開動画リンクから音楽・効果音を作り、動画に合わせて音声をミックスする。
